notes_for_editor: Thin: the only source naming this tower is one line in a 2016 list of Georgia lookout towers. Two WebSearch calls and page reads found nothing on construction, staffing, fate or the site today. The brief's register GFC US 848 matches the list's gfc-848, but the list does not explain the code, so the story reports it only as printed. A Firetower Road in Brunswick (Glynn County) appeared in a real-estate listing; it does not name a tower and was not used. No Wikipedia article for Brookman, Georgia was found at the URL tried (404). Brief status and access stay unknown.
